iterations.changes: Added an ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English output-language section to all five skills (spring_clean, rebug, audit, address-pr-comments, pr-review). Iterated once inside the iteration: v1 measurably shed file:line citations, so v2 adds a 'Do not lose information' rule — STE limits sentence length, not the number of sentences or facts; keep every number, citation, and downstream effect; the six-sentence cap is per paragraph, so use more paragraphs or a vertical list.

arms.ste2: STE section v1 + 'Do not lose information'

iterations.notes: STE conformance improved on every skill with no structural regression: template_pass_rate stayed 1.0 in all arms, recall stayed 1.0, and address-pr-comments kept 100% verdict accuracy with both false-positive traps caught. The one real regression in v1 was information loss — citations per finding roughly halved on spring_clean (4.28 -> 1.94) and rebug (4.7 -> 1.87), because a sentence-length budget invites dropping the subordinate clause that carried a quantity or an extra location. v2 fixes it: citations recover to 3.42 and quantities rise above baseline (1.78 -> 4.05), while conformance holds or improves. Side benefit: the 'keep the section titles and field names exactly as they are' rule hardened template fidelity — the base arm drifted to [CRITICAL] casing and numbered '### Issue 3:' headings, the STE arms did not. Two eval-asset defects found and recorded in iteration-4/ground_truth_eventbus.json corrections: MemoryStorage is mislabelled clean, and the RetryMiddleware clean label needs to name with_retry() rather than the class.
iterations.caveats: One sample per arm, so differences under roughly 10 percent are inside run-to-run variance. Recall saturates at 1.0 because test-repo sources carry greppable '# BUG [CATEGORY]:' annotations, so recall cannot detect a small loss of discovery — a blind copy is the next harness fix. pr-review is confounded: its base arm came from c1019cd, which predates both the STE section and the uncommitted 'Simplicity & economy' taxonomy, so its base-vs-ste delta mixes two changes. That work is committed separately, immediately before this iteration, so the next pr-review measurement has a clean baseline.

iterations.changes: New skill perform-like-jeff-dean: performance audit distilled from Abseil's Performance Hints. Hot/cold classification before flagging, back-of-envelope Estimate field anchored in the latency-numbers table, 6-category taxonomy, and a P1-P4 priority matrix (impact x effort) so quick wins rank first; cold-code inefficiencies become one-line notes. New eval assets: test-repo/perfburn (18 planted issues, 6 FP traps, no in-source BUG annotations) and priority_score.py (pairwise order accuracy, label accuracy, section-aware recall, trap hits on unmatched findings only). 10 ground-truth labels corrected after arithmetic review, recorded in the corrections array. v2 (one ralph-wiggum cycle later): sweep cold files with the same patterns (hits become Cold-Code Notes) and record every dismissed candidate in Not Found with the dismissing number.

arms.base: stub-perf.md, a 2-line prompt with no skill body
arms.v2: v1 + cold-file pattern sweep + record dismissals in Not Found (4bc5785)

iterations.notes: The stub baseline found issues but produced no parseable template, so its structure and priority metrics are zero/absent by construction. The v1 report's estimates exposed 10 miscalibrated ground-truth labels (e.g. re.compile is cached by CPython; SELECT * over a 432M-row day is High, not Medium; the 'startup-only' index build actually runs per CLI query invocation and has no reader). All 6 FP traps handled correctly: cold inefficiencies went to Cold-Code Notes, the lru_cache and batched-flush traps were explicitly dismissed or praised. v2 verdict: recall_total 1.0 (PB-ALGO-3 caught), precision and STE up, cost down 16%. citations_per_finding dropped 34% on perfburn but rose 42% on eventbus under the same skill text; inspection showed de-duplication of repeated chain/README citations with unique files cited unchanged - judged variance plus compression of redundancy, not information loss. All stop-rule targets met at v2; loop stopped per rule (a).
iterations.caveats: Single sample per arm (<10% deltas are noise). The only true miss is PB-ALGO-3 (sorted() for top-10 in the daily reportgen). Label-accuracy denominators are matched ranked findings only.
